purpose: Lets a user choose one option from a predefined list. Use when there are enough options that showing them all at once would crowd the layout — typically more than four. For three or fewer options, prefer radio buttons or a button group so all choices stay visible.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label for the field. Always required — a field without a label is inaccessible.

props.name: options
props.description: The list of choices. Each option needs a machine-readable value and a human-readable label.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Empty first option shown before a choice is made, e.g. 'Choose a country'. Disabled so the user cannot re-select it once they have chosen.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: When set, puts the field into an error state and displays this message below the select. Must explain what went wrong and how to fix it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field. Prefer hiding it or explaining why it is unavailable.

variants.name: default
variants.whenToUse: Any time the user needs to pick one value from a list of five or more options where showing all choices at once would crowd the layout.

variants.name: error
variants.whenToUse: After the user has submitted or left the field without making a selection, or when the selected value fails validation. Always pair with an errorMessage.

states.name: default
states.description: Resting state. Neutral border, white background, chevron visible.

states.name: focus
states.description: Keyboard or pointer focus. Border and outline shift to the focus-ring token.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Non-interactive. Uses disabled surface and text tokens, not-allowed cursor, chevron dims to disabled text token.

states.name: error
states.description: Validation has failed. Border and message use the error token. aria-invalid is set.

antiPatterns.never: Use Select when there are three or fewer options.
antiPatterns.because: A dropdown hides its options behind a click. When there are only a few choices, radio buttons or a button group keep everything visible and require less effort from the user.

antiPatterns.never: Replace the label with only a placeholder.
antiPatterns.because: A placeholder disappears once a choice is made, leaving the user unable to recall what the field was asking. The label must always be visible.

antiPatterns.never: Build a custom styled dropdown without implementing full keyboard navigation.
antiPatterns.because: The native select's keyboard behaviour — Up/Down to move, Enter to confirm, Escape to dismiss — is provided by the browser for free. A custom dropdown built from divs loses all of that and must reimplement it correctly, including aria-expanded, aria-haspopup, aria-activedescendant, and focus management. If that work is not done, the component is inaccessible.

antiPatterns.never: Set raw colour or spacing values on the select.
antiPatterns.because: Unbound values are invisible to the design system and to an agent reading it. Always bind to a token.

keyboard: Tab moves focus into the field
Up and Down arrows move between options when open
Enter or Space opens the list and confirms a selection
Escape closes the list without changing the selection
accessibility.focus: Native focus order. Visible 2px focus ring on :focus-visible using the focus-ring token, offset by 2px. Focus ring colour shifts to error token when in error state.
aria: aria-describedby points to the error message element when errorMessage is set
label is always associated via htmlFor/id — never use aria-label as a substitute for a visible label
accessibility.contrast: Error red on white meets WCAG AA 4.5:1. Disabled text on disabled surface meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 for the default token set.

agentNotes: When generating a form field for a bounded list of values — countries, languages, time zones, roles — reach for Select. When the list has four or fewer items and space permits, prefer radio buttons to keep choices visible. Never generate a Select without a label. If a placeholder is used, it should name the category being chosen, not repeat the label ('Choose a country', not 'Country').
